description: Defines the Label class used for representing target names and paths in build system, including methods for resolution, comparison, and formatting.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a build target label with path, name, and optional toolchain info, including comparison and formatting methods.

methods.name: Label()
methods.description: Default constructor for Label.

methods.name: Label(const SourceDir&, std::string_view, const SourceDir&, std::string_view)
methods.description: Constructs a Label with specified directory, name, toolchain directory, and toolchain name.

methods.name: Label(const SourceDir&, std::string_view)
methods.description: Constructs a Label with specified directory and name, with an empty toolchain.

methods.name: static Label Resolve(const SourceDir&, std::string_view, const Label&, const Value&, Err*)
methods.description: Resolves a string from a build file into a fully qualified Label.

methods.name: bool is_null() const
methods.description: Checks if the label is null (invalid).

methods.name: const SourceDir& dir() const
methods.description: Returns the directory part of the label.

methods.name: const std::string& name() const
methods.description: Returns the name part of the label.

methods.name: StringAtom name_atom() const
methods.description: Returns the name as a StringAtom.

methods.name: const SourceDir& toolchain_dir() const
methods.description: Returns the toolchain directory.

methods.name: const std::string& toolchain_name() const
methods.description: Returns the toolchain name.

methods.name: StringAtom toolchain_name_atom() const
methods.description: Returns the toolchain name as a StringAtom.

methods.name: Label GetToolchainLabel() const
methods.description: Returns a Label representing the toolchain.

methods.name: Label GetWithNoToolchain() const
methods.description: Returns a copy of the label with an empty toolchain.

methods.name: std::string GetUserVisibleName(bool include_toolchain) const
methods.description: Formats label for user display, optionally including the toolchain.

methods.name: std::string GetUserVisibleName(const Label& default_toolchain) const
methods.description: Formats label for user display, including toolchain if not default.

methods.name: bool operator==(const Label& other) const
methods.description: Equality comparison operator.

methods.name: bool operator!=(const Label& other) const
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator.

methods.name: bool operator<(const Label& other) const
methods.description: Less-than comparison operator for ordering.

methods.name: bool ToolchainsEqual(const Label& other) const
methods.description: Checks if toolchain parts are equal.

methods.name: size_t hash() const
methods.description: Returns the hash value of the label.
